records.original_sql: CREATE TEMP TABLE cache_baseline AS SELECT hits, inserts FROM vgi_result_cache_stats();
records.replacement_sql: CREATE TABLE cache_baseline AS SELECT hits, inserts FROM vgi_result_cache_stats();
records.reason: Each SQLLogicTest file owns one isolated DataFusion SessionContext, so a session catalog table has the same lifetime and one-row snapshot semantics as DuckDB's temporary table here.

records.replacement_sql:
